newsitem.title: GERMANY: China to stick with reform course, Qiao Shi says.
newsitem.headline: China to stick with reform course, Qiao Shi says.

text.p: Qiao Shi, the chairman of China's parliament, said in a German newspaper interview to be published on Wednesday that China would not reverse its reform course.

"China will not take any steps backwards in its policies of reform and openness," Qiao told the Handelsblatt business daily, according to an excerpt the paper made available on Wednesday. The paper said the interview took place in Beijing.
"Neither the communist party, nor the people would permit that," he was quoted as saying.
Qiao said the Chinese parliament would continue to take steps to create laws and systems that would not change "because of a change in leadership or a change in view by a leading personality."
But he also said that China would not be trying to create a western style democracy.
